title: $100 Cashback on Optus 350GB Flex Plus $395 365-Day Prepaid SIM (now $225) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: $100 Cashback on Optus 350GB Flex Plus $395 365-Day Prepaid SIM (now $225) @ TopCashback AU

[Wilburre] I wonder when the cashback ends, I need to port from Vodafone 365 before Christmas day and this would be perfect.
[trouble11111111] My nbn is with Optus. Am I entitled to the cashback if buying the yearly SIM card?
I don’t remember the answer I saw in the previous cashback deals.
Help! Voda is expiring. Can’t wait to move out.
[trouble11111111] And just realised I had a prepaid mobile number using the 365 days plan.
Any workaround?
A new Optus account? Or new TopCashback account?
[trouble11111111] The mobile number I want to port in is with Voda currently.
[Hiphopopotamus] Should be fine?
Prepaid cashback is eligible on new activations only and requires activation within 28 days of purchase. Service must maintain an active recharge state for a minimum 90 days after activation.
[park it] @Hiphopopotamus: Also says “ Cashback is eligible for new sign-ups (new Optus) customers only.”
[Hiphopopotamus] @park it: That is presumably for the other cashback categories, don't quote me on that though as I'm just trying to make sense of the same information you're seeing.
[bob19] @Hiphopopotamus: Another question: If I already have one mobile service with Optus but want another one with a different number under the same name and address, am I considered a new Optus customer or not?
[bob19] @Hiphopopotamus: Thank you, Hiphopopotamus.
Should I order a physical SIM and then convert it to eSIM or I can order eSIM straightaway?
